titleInfo.airedHint: The day it was first shown, as 2008-01-20.
titleInfo.castHint: In credit order. Remove everyone to go back to the cast from the .nfo or TMDB.
titleInfo.contentRatingHint: Such as 12, PG-13 or FR-12. Profiles with an age limit go by this rating.
titleInfo.directorsHint: Separate names with commas. They show after Directed by.
titleInfo.hint: What you write here shows instead of the text from the .nfo or TMDB, in every language. A field left empty keeps the text shown in grey.
titleInfo.name: Title
titleInfo.originalTitleHint: The title in its original language, such as Das Boot. It shows under the title.
titleInfo.releasedHint: Just the year, as 1995, or the day, as 1995-12-15.
titleInfo.sortTitleHint: The title is sorted under this name, such as Lord of the Rings, The. The title shown stays the same.
titleInfo.studiosHint: Separate names with commas, such as A24 or HBO.
titleInfo.taglineHint: A short line shown above the summary.
titleInfo.title: Info
